name: Confirming a booking updates all three derived views together

statusDetails.message: Request: POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"} on a free slot. Observed confirmation HTTP 200 slot ss-1 17:00–18:30. Re-read of the same booking: schedule holder 12 status held end 18:30; posted list shows apartment 12 for that slot; heater schedule heats pukuhuone 8 Tuesday 17:00–18:30; invoicing signal inv-1 type standing_slot_charge names apartment 12 for that slot. Consequence: the posted list, heater schedule and billing signal all match the one confirmed booking.

labels.name: story
labels.value: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing
